title: Learning from Duality in Neural Network Field Theories
abstract: arXiv:2611.21503v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop neural realizations of positive-level Wess-Zumino-Witten models using bosonic Wakimoto and fermionic Fourier-Berezin fields. Level-rank duality connects the charged sectors of the fermionic construction, where explicit neural observables recover conformal block data and enable the transfer of information about unknown correlators between paired theories. We also show that distinct neural presentations of the same continuum current algebra exhibit different finite-width behavior, with approximation accuracy depending on architecture, regulator, and parameter distribution. These results connect the exact mathematical structure of conformal field theory with the expressive and computational properties of neural field theories.

translated_title: 《从神经网络场理论中的对偶性中学习》
translated_abstract: 我们利用玻色Wakimoto场和费米Fourier-Berezin场开发了正能级Wess-Zumino-Witten模型的神经实现。能级-秩对偶将费米构造中的带电扇区联系起来，其中显式的神经观测量能够恢复共形块数据，并实现在配对理论之间传递关于未知关联函数的信息。我们还证明了同一连续流代数的不同神经表示会表现出不同的有限宽度行为，其近似精度取决于网络架构、调节器和参数分布。这些结果将共形场论的精确数学结构与神经场理论的表达能力和计算性质联系起来。
tldr: 本文通过玻色Wakimoto场与费米Fourier-Berezin场实现了正能级Wess-Zumino-Witten模型的神经实现，利用能级-秩对偶恢复共形块数据并实现配对理论间的信息传递，同时揭示了同一流代数的不同神经表示具有不同的有限宽度行为。
en_tdlr: This paper develops neural realizations of positive-level Wess-Zumino-Witten models using bosonic Wakimoto and fermionic Fourier-Berezin fields, showing that level-rank duality enables recovery of conformal block data and information transfer between paired theories, while distinct neural representations of the same current algebra exhibit different finite-width behaviors.
